meta.title: Lobster, Crab & Giant Shrimp FEAST at Nam Danh Seafood Da Nang!
meta.description:
Join us as we dive into one of Da Nang’s most popular local food spots — Nam Danh Seafood!
In this episode, we picked our seafood straight from the tanks and went all in with lobster, crab, and giant shrimp. Everything was fresh, juicy, and packed with flavor. This is easily one of the best seafood meals we’ve had in Vietnam!
📍 Nam Danh Seafood, Da Nang, Vietnam
🍽 Fresh catch of the day
🦞 Lobster
🦀 Crab
🍤 Large shrimps
If you’re visiting Da Nang and want an authentic, affordable, and delicious seafood experience, this spot is a must-try.
Don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe to Traveling With Mikey for more food adventures and travel guides!
